For years, the digital product playbook has been the same: write the ebook, build the course, sell the PDF, find the next customer, repeat. It works... I've built a $30M+ business on it. But there's a quieter shift happening underneath the creator economy right now, and most people selling digital products haven't caught it yet.

The shift isn't what you sell. It's how the revenue stacks.

In this breakdown, I rebuild the core of a $150M/year app from scratch... no developers, no engineering team, no code... using a single AI tool. Then I show you the part most creators miss: how to wrap that app in a real selling system so it actually generates monthly recurring revenue instead of sitting in a folder.

You'll learn:
1️⃣ Why one-time digital product sales quietly cap your income (and the simple structural change that uncaps it)

4️⃣ The pricing logic behind premium subscription apps (and why most creators undercharge by 3-4x on their first try)

6️⃣ The shift I had to make personally after spending months and six figures hiring engineers to build software the old way

I built my first software company the hard way... months of development cycles, a full engineering team, the kind of overhead that quietly eats your margins before you ever see a customer. That company crossed $500K/month. What I'm showing you in this video would have saved me most of that pain.

This isn't about replacing digital products. It's about evolving them. Same audience. Same content. Same marketing skillset. Different revenue model, one that compounds every month instead of resetting every sale.
